title: Nexus PatternManifest
description: Declarative manifest of one pattern package directory (`pattern.toml`). A manifest is data, never authority: it records what the package declares. Readability, IR compatibility, effect-rollup agreement, trust and loadability are runtime facts owned by the registry reader, and none of them is claimed here.

id.description: Package id. It MUST equal the package directory name; a mismatch is an unavailable package, never an alias.

version.description: SemVer 2.0.0 version label. It is a human version selector, never the content identity: the pin is the canonical content hash of the package's IR fragment, so two packages may declare the same version with different bytes.

ir_compat.title: PatternIrCompat
ir_compat.description: Inclusive range of workflow IR versions this package supports. A package whose range excludes the daemon's current `ir_version` is unavailable.

max.description: Highest supported IR version (inclusive). `min > max` is an invalid range and makes the package unavailable.

description.description: Non-empty human label shown wherever the package is listed.

effect_class.description: Worst-case effect this package declares for its fragment. The reader compares it with its own rollup of the fragment; a disagreement makes the package unavailable and neither value is rewritten.

slots.description: Named slot declarations, possibly empty. Slot names are unique within the manifest.

requires_capabilities.description: Non-empty unique capability ids the package requires; instantiation unions them into the parent. Capability presence is checked by shared semantic validation, not by this manifest.
